blurb: Our taproom is a great place to have a good time. Whether you are sitting at the bar solo or have come with a large group of friends or family, our taproom is a place to relax, catch a great band, or celebrate a special occasion within site of our 7-barrel brew house. It also makes a great place to host a party or fundraising event.
